description: Incident repro from webapp PR #36024 (SEC-620 benchmark Row 2, reviewed at commit d861af720f8b, before the follow-up fix #36040 was merged into the PR): the gap-detector resolver switched student-facing display from itemDataAnswerless to full itemData, so GetNextAssessmentItem now assigns the assessment item JSON 'complete with answers' (fetchAssessmentItemJson's own docstring) to SimpleAssessmentItem.Content, whose GraphQL schema docstring promises 'The Perseus content of the item without answers.' Every getNextAssessmentItem response delivers the answers to the student's browser; the PR description defers stripping to a future frontend change, which would not stop answers leaving the server. The human reviewer and the SEC-620 baseline reviewer both missed the docstring/runtime contradiction; it was fixed after merge review via PR #36040. The unchanged schema file (services/progress/assessment_item.graphql) and the full-data fetcher (cross_service/assessment_item.go) are staged in the tree as the discoverability chain for the promise and the runtime.

evidence_trace: services/progress/assessment_item.graphql:48 documents SimpleAssessmentItem.content as "The Perseus content of the item without answers."
services/progress/resolvers/gap_detector.go:526 now fetches the item via fetchAssessmentItemJson, whose docstring (line 409) says it returns the item JSON "complete with answers"
services/progress/resolvers/gap_detector.go:534 assigns that JSON to SimpleAssessmentItem.Content unmodified
the deleted cross_service/assessment_items.go removed the only answerless fetch path, and the PR description defers answer-stripping to a future frontend change
finding.failure_scenario: A student taking a gap-detector assessment issues the getNextAssessmentItem query and receives the full Perseus itemData JSON -- including the correct answers, rubric, and hints -- in SimpleAssessmentItem.content; opening the browser network tab reveals the answer to every item before the student responds.
finding.model_authored_prose: The GraphQL schema documents `SimpleAssessmentItem.content` as "The Perseus content of the item without answers," but this now assigns the output of `fetchAssessmentItemJson` -- the item JSON "complete with answers" per its own docstring -- to that field. Every assessment item reaches the student's browser with its answers embedded; stripping in the frontend later (the stated upcoming work) does not fix this, because the answers still leave the server. Strip answers server-side before populating `content`, or change the field's documented contract.

prContext.title: Remove itemDataAnswerless
prContext.description:
## Summary:
Switch gap detector to use itemData instead of itemDataAnswerless

The itemDataAnswerless field is not being populated during the SSS
migration, causing blank pages when displaying assessment items.
Switch to using itemData for both display and scoring.

Remove duplicate assessment_items.go and consolidate to single
GetAssessmentItem function.

Upcoming work: Frontend should separately strip answers using splitPerseusItem().

Issue: TUT-3215 

## Test plan:
Testing:
-Modified existing unit tests.
-Loaded gap detector in the frontend and verified that can still answer questions.
prContext.author: sxkosone
